body: Yeah, that does look a bit cleaner 👍 One small nitpick, maybe append keys to the variable names (e.g. dock3_keys, dock4_keys, dock5_keys) so it’s clearer those are collections rather than single values.

I tried to do something like
```C++
default_layout->set_value(docks_section, "dock_3", vformat("%s,%s",
	SceneTreeDock::get_singleton()->get_effective_layout_key(),
	ImportDock::get_singleton()->get_effective_layout_key()
));
```
but the formatter does not allow me to do that.

I went with a modified first option. It's super verbose, but more readable I guess.
